main_body: Fern foliage fan (green leaf mass, rows 1-8) over a tapered terracotta pot (rows 9-14)
top_band: Pot: a dark brown rim line at rows 9-10, with no soil or opening ellipse above the lighter peach face. The foliage is a leaf blob with no separate horizontal surface.
evidence: The pot is a front-view bowl. Only a 1-2 row dark rim sits at the top, and no soil or interior is visible from above. The peach and orange body below reads as a vertical face with a light-to-dark gradient. This is the 'rim only' failure from the guide, because the thin rim does not read as a surface. The fern is a flat leaf silhouette with no clear top and front split.

style.evidence: The leaves have about 4 greens, from pale yellow-green to dark green, and the pot has about 3-4 browns. The outlines lean dark green or brown rather than black, which is good. The terracotta body is a smooth band of flat orange with little grain or speckle, and the leaves lack the clump-by-clump texture of the reference trees. Overall it is thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references.
